description: Primary palm lines catalog for the Palmistry & Tarot Intelligence Platform (Spec §49.5, FR-009).

lines.name: Life Line
lines.description: Curves around the base of the thumb (Mount of Venus); represents vitality, physical energy, health stamina, and significant life transitions.
significance: major life transitions and geographic relocations
quality of life energy and enthusiasm
lines.starting_zone: Radial edge of the palm between the index finger (Jupiter) and thumb (Venus).
lines.ending_zone: Base of the palm near the wrist (Rascettes) curving around Mount of Venus.

variations.description: Long, clear, and well-defined line curving gracefully around the thumb.
variations.meaning: Vibrant vitality, strong constitution, steady stamina, and grounded physical presence.

variations.description: Thin, superficial line requiring close inspection to trace.
variations.meaning: Sensitive constitution, needing deliberate rest, prone to nervous energy exhaustion.

variations.description: Sweeps broadly toward the center of the palm before descending.
variations.meaning: Expansive enthusiasm, generous warm heart, love of adventure and travel.

variations.description: Stays tightly enclosed against the ball of the thumb.
variations.meaning: Cautious nature, introverted reserve, conservative with energy and resources.

variations.description: Branching into two or more strands as it reaches the wrist.
variations.meaning: Travel abroad, profound life shift in maturity, dual residences or pursuits.

lines.name: Head Line
lines.description: Traverses horizontally across the palm between the Life and Heart lines; governs cognitive style, intellect, reasoning focus, and mental processing.
lines.starting_zone: Originates near or joined with the Life Line above the Mount of Venus.
lines.ending_zone: Crosses the palm toward the Mount of Mars (percussive edge) or slants down toward the Mount of Moon.

variations.description: Extends directly across the palm toward the upper percussion (Mount of Mars).
variations.meaning: Highly practical, logical, data-driven, objective problem solver with disciplined focus.

variations.description: Curving gently downward toward the fleshy base of the Mount of Moon.
variations.meaning: Rich creative imagination, artistic sensitivity, intuitive cognition, literary flair.

variations.description: Splits into a distinct fork near the termination (one branch straight, one dipping to Moon).
variations.meaning: The Writer's Fork: rare blend of analytical pragmatism and brilliant creative imagination.

variations.description: Originates entwined with the Life Line for a centimeter or more.
variations.meaning: Deeply reflective, cautious start in youth, values family counsel, considerate.

variations.description: Clear gap between the start of the Head Line and Life Line.
variations.meaning: Independent thinker, pioneering spirit, bold self-confidence, takes initiative early.

lines.name: Heart Line
lines.description: Runs across the upper palm below the fingers; governs emotional depth, romantic style, empathy, compassion, and interpersonal vulnerability.
significance: romantic ideals, loyalty, and relationship patterns
empathy, social compassion, and emotional boundaries
lines.starting_zone: Ulnar percussion of the hand below the little finger (Mercury).
lines.ending_zone: Sweeps across the upper palm toward the Mount of Jupiter (index) or Mount of Saturn (middle).

variations.description: Curving upward and terminating gracefully under the index finger (Mount of Jupiter).
variations.meaning: Idealistic in love, affectionate, noble expectations, warm-hearted, deeply loyal partner.

variations.description: Flat, straight trajectory terminating beneath the middle finger (Mount of Saturn).
variations.meaning: Realistic, emotionally guarded, values stability and demonstrated action over romantic idealism.

variations.description: Balanced termination right in the valley between the index and middle fingers.
variations.meaning: Golden emotional balance: gives love warmly while maintaining healthy self-respect and boundaries.

variations.description: Small island links or feathery branches along the line.
variations.meaning: High emotional sensitivity, deeply empathetic, absorbs energy of surroundings easily.

lines.name: Fate Line
lines.description: Ascends vertically up the center of the palm toward the middle finger (Mount of Saturn); reflects vocation, sense of purpose, life direction, and external karmic tides.
significance: career path clarity and professional dedication
sense of purpose and vocational direction
pivotal career shifts and vocational transitions
lines.starting_zone: Base of palm near the wrist, or rising from the Life Line or Mount of Moon.

variations.description: Continuous, unbroken vertical column from wrist to Saturn mount.
variations.meaning: Unshakable vocational clarity from an early age, self-directed achievement, high career focus.

variations.description: Originates from the fleshy Mount of Moon (outer palm edge).
variations.meaning: Career dependent on public rapport, client charisma, artistic recognition, or support of others.

variations.description: Sprouts from the Life Line further up the hand.
variations.meaning: Self-made success: career breakthroughs won through personal grit and dedicated perseverance.

variations.description: Faint, intermittent, or absent.
variations.meaning: Flexible, self-authored journey: free from rigid corporate ladders, crafting varied eclectic paths.

lines.name: Sun Line
lines.description: Runs vertically parallel to the Fate Line toward the ring finger (Mount of Apollo); signifies public recognition, charisma, artistic fulfillment, and personal magnetism.
significance: artistic talent, aesthetic refinement, and creative genius
reward and recognition fulfilling career labor
lines.starting_zone: Lower palm, or ascending from Heart Line, Head Line, or Fate Line.
lines.ending_zone: Mount of Apollo (base of the ring finger).

variations.description: Clear vertical line reaching onto the Apollo mount.
variations.meaning: Profound artistic brilliance, high public visibility, magnetic charisma, acknowledged success.

variations.description: Begins only above the Heart Line and ascends into Apollo.
variations.meaning: Late-blooming brilliance: public recognition, joy, and greatest success achieved in mature years.

variations.description: Two or three slender parallel lines ascending under ring finger.
variations.meaning: Versatile creative interests, multiple concurrent artistic pursuits, widely appreciated.

variations.description: Not visibly delineated on palm surface.
variations.meaning: Quiet fulfillment: success achieved through steadfast internal satisfaction rather than celebrity or fame.
